transcript:
[thoughtful] [reflective]
Ye ek soch ki cheez hai... kaise same biology alag alag cultures ko ek jaisi awaaz tak le aayi.
[authoritative] [informative]
Kuch linguists... jaise Merritt Ruhlen aur Mark Pagel... dava karte hain ki kuch shabd pandrah hazaar saal ya usse bhi purane ho sakte hain... aur unhone modern languages ki alag alag shakhaon ka ek common source tak trace karne ki koshish ki.

[honest] [direct]
Toh honest jawab? Hum abhi tak nahi jaante ki pehli language kya thi. Ya kya woh ek thi.
